coverage.main: Read all eight pages of arXiv 1806.02299v4 (23 April 2019; SafeAI@AAAI workshop paper), including the approach, experiments, Tables 1-5, Figures 1-11 and references.
coverage.supplement: No appendix or supplement is included or linked. No separate workshop proceedings version was retrieved; arXiv v4 is the latest version.
coverage.excluded_results: Untargeted/targeted DPATCH rows in Tables 1-2, Tables 3-4, Figures 4-8 and 10-11 evaluate the detector on which the patch was trained (white-box/same-model). Figures 1, 5, 7 and 9 are qualitative.

result_groups.locator: Section 'Detector Transferability of DPATCH' (p. 6); Table 1 'YOLO trained DPATCH' row and Table 2 'Faster R-CNN trained DPATCH' row (p. 5)
result_groups.population: Pascal VOC 2007 test set; a single YOLO-trained (person-targeted) or Faster R-CNN-trained patch applied to each test image
result_groups.outcome: per-class AP and mAP of the other detector
result_groups.evidence: The patch trained on one detector is applied to each test image and the other detector's mAP is reported beside its no-DPATCH mAP. mAP is a dataset-level detection metric: no per-image clean-correct event or source-success event is defined, and no selection is described.

result_groups.population: Untargeted patch trained on COCO (training detector not specified) applied to Pascal VOC test images for VOC-trained Faster R-CNN and YOLO
result_groups.evidence: Same dataset-level mAP outcome with no-DPatch baselines; the COCO training detector is unspecified, so source identity and source-side performance are unknown.

f1.evidence: Clean (no-DPATCH) mAP is reported separately for YOLO (65.7%), Faster R-CNN VGG16 (70.01%) and ResNet101 (75.1%), which is positive per-model baseline reporting for detection. The COCO-trained patch's source detector and its clean performance are not reported, and mAP is not a classification clean accuracy; complete coverage is not established.

f2.evidence: No clean-correct event is defined for dataset-level mAP; not an explicit inclusion statement.

f3.evidence: A universal patch is applied to each test image; per-image source success is undefined for mAP evaluation, so neither explicit conditioning nor explicit retention of source failures is established.

f4.evidence: Results are average precisions, not proportions with integer numerators; the test-set size is not stated in the paper.

f5.locator: DPATCH Formulation Eqs. 2-3 (p. 3); DPATCH Design (p. 3); Multiple-Sized DPATCH (p. 6)
f5.evidence: The attack optimizes patch pixels without a norm constraint (Eqs. 2-3); perturbation size is defined by patch area (20, 40 or 80 pixels square), not an L-infinity or L2 radius. This is an explicit threat-model choice for patch attacks, reported in the non-classification stratum, not an omitted budget.

f6.evidence: The paper links no code. A repository by user veralauee (plausibly the first author, not confirmed from the paper) provides a YOLOv2 PyTorch implementation with train/test scripts and Drive links for YOLO weights and a trained patch; no Faster R-CNN implementation or checkpoints, so neither cross-detector transfer direction is covered. Drive contents not verified.

artifact_checks.result: Cloned and pinned (71 tracked files, last commit 21 January 2019). YOLOv2 (longcw yolo2-pytorch based) training/testing of DPATCH on VOC 2007; README links Google Drive for yolo-voc.weights.h5 and one trained patch. No Faster R-CNN code or weights, no per-image outputs. Not executed.
Search returned 47 repositories; only veralauee/DPatch matched the paper; others were unrelated or third-party generalizations. Bounded search.

bounds_checks.reason: Detection mAP is not a fixed-predictor misclassification probability; the classification bound is not applicable.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit; non-classification detection outcome recorded in the applicability stratum.
No release execution; authorship of the unlinked repository is not established from the paper.
